repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T17:28Z · #36147: the existing behaviours the card's items 5–7 change (reviewed by fable first)

At 2026-11-21T17:26Z the maintainer picked option A on the seat's decision card, 「全部按卡」:

1. Read-only fields: clicking the row no longer copies. On desktop, the copy icon on hover or keyboard focus stays. On phone there is no copy icon, and the value is copied by long-press text selection; the thread checks on a device that long-press selects the value.
2. Editable fields: a single click on the value enters edit (it was a double-click), with no pencil. The same holds on phone (where a tap used to copy).
3. Relation chips and links: clicking the chip or link opens it; clicking the rest of the row's value edits (the #36015 precedent).
4. Empty fields: one "show N empty fields" row at the end of the field area, collapsed by default, replacing the ratio rule; the open choice is remembered per object.
5. System info: the footer line (objectui#12307) becomes the last group, collapsed by default.
6. Chip colour: the field area uses the object colour, per #35985. The grey list chip is recorded on #35985 as its follow-up.

Unchanged whatever the option: one column, the same face on all three surfaces, the group chevron on the right, one save bar, field permissions and masked fields not copyable, the remembered expand state, multi-column on a full page with no left column.
